input.quote: PB shall notify SFJ in writing of the total amount of Development Costs (inclusive of all Development Costs paid or incurred since the Effective Date) that PB elects to have SFJ fund
input.rationale: Section 4.2.3(ii) obliges PB to elect at least $110 million of SFJ funding once the Successful Phase 3 Interim Analysis is achieved ("which shall be no less than $110 million and no more than $120 million"). Because Approval Payments are scaled to the Development Costs actually funded (Section 6.2), the floor operates as a multi-year minimum draw/take-or-pay on our client: PB must take, and ultimately pay for at the Approval Payment multiple, funding it may not need. The floor is not limited to a 12-month period, is not reducible on 30 days' notice, and there is no shortfall true-up in PB's favour, so the fallback is not met on its material terms (PB's at-will exit in Section 14.2.2 carries a 300% payment, which we address separately under the liquidated damages rule and do not re-flag here). The shortest cure is to delete the floor, leaving PB's election capped at $120 million; Section 6.2's pro rata adjustment already ensures PB pays only for what SFJ actually funds. The overrun allocation in Sections 4.1/4.2.3 and the use-of-proceeds covenant requiring PB to spend at least the amount funded are cost-allocation and application-of-funds terms rather than purchase minimums, and are noted only.

proposal.summary: Remove the $110 million floor on the Elected Total Amount so PB has no minimum funding commitment.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the $110 million floor on the Elected Total Amount so that PB elects only the funding it actually needs, up to the $120 million cap; Section 6.2 already scales the Approval Payments to the Development Costs actually funded. Our position is no minimum commitment, but we could accept a floor limited to the current 12-month period and reducible on 30 days' notice.

ops.oldText: which shall be no less than $110 million and no more than $120 million
ops.newText: which shall be no more than $120 million

mappings.element: Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment.
Customer pays only for usage or ordered Services.
mappings.quote: the Approval Payments will be multiplied by a fraction, the numerator of which is such actual amount of Development Costs paid or incurred by SFJ hereunder (as adjusted, to the extent applicable, pursuant to Section 2.3.3, Section 3.12.2 and/or Section 3.12.3) and the denominator of which is One Hundred Twenty Million U.S. Dollars ($120,000,000.00)
